title: Street Fighter Movie Cracks Over $50M at Box Office in Opening Weekend
summary:
Round two soon?

There had been some concern over whether audiences would show up for the new live action Street Fighter movie, but it managed to top the worldwide box office this weekend with a $51.1 million international haul.

While optimists had been hoping for a number closer to $70 million, unless ticket sales fall off a cliff over the coming weeks, this is a decent result for the film, which was made on an $82 million budget, according to Deadline.
